Document.name: ETABS Verification Examples Main
Document.description: Title, Copyright, Contents, Log, Methodology, Conclusions.

Document.name: Example 1 - Static Gravity Load Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a one-story, two-dimensional frame subjected to vertical static loading.

Document.name: Example 2 - Dynamic Response Spectrum Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a three-story plane frame subjected to the El Centro 1940 seismic response spectra, N-S component with 5 percent damping.

Document.name: Example 3 - Code Specified Static Lateral Load Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a three-story plane frame subjected to UBC 1997 seismic loads, IBC 2000 seismic loads, and UBC 1997 wind loads.

Document.name: Example 4 - Dynamic Response Spectrum Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a one-story, four-bay, three-dimensional frame subjected to the El Centro 1940 N-S component seismic response spectrum for 5 percent damping, applied in two orthogonal directions.

Document.name: Example 5 - Dynamic Response Spectrum Analysis
Document.description: This example considers an L-shaped structure with four identical braced frames, subjected to the El Centro 1940 N-S component seismic response spectrum for 5 percent damping, applied in the X-direction.

Document.name: Example 6 - Eigenvalue Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a nine-story, ten-bay plane frame, for which an eigenvalue analysis is performed.

Document.name: Example 7 - Gravity and Lateral Loads Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a seven-story plane frame subjected to static, response spectrum, and time history loading.

Document.name: Example 8 - Dynamic Response Spectrum Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a two-story, three-dimensional frame subjected to a response spectrum of constant amplitude.

Document.name: Example 9 - Dynamic Response Spectrum Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a two-story, three-dimensional unsymmetrical frame subjected to a seismic response spectrum along two horizontal axes that are at a 30-degree angle to the building axes.

Document.name: Example 10 - Nonlinear Time History Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a single bay, three-story plane frame subjected to the El Centro 1940 N-S time history record for a nonlinear time history analysis.

Document.name: Example 11 - Nonlinear Time History Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a three-story plane frame with viscous damper elements subjected to the El Centro 1940 N-S time history record for a nonlinear time history analysis.

Document.name: Example 12 - Nonlinear Time History Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a two-bay, seven-story plane frame linked to a one-bay, four-story plane frame using gap link elements. The structure is subjected to the El Centro 1940 N-S time history record for a nonlinear time history analysis.

Document.name: Example 13 - Nonlinear Time History Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a two-story, three-dimensional frame with base isolation subjected to earthquake motion in two perpendicular directions using the Loma Prieta acceleration records.

Document.name: Example 14 - Nonlinear Time History Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a two-story, three-dimensional frame with friction pendulum base isolators subjected to earthquake motion in two perpendicular directions usig the Loma Prieta acceleration records.

Document.name: Example 15 - Static Lateral Loads Analysis
Document.description: This example considers a series of wall configurations subjected to a static lateral load for verifying the area object with wall section assignments.
